items.title: American Express vs. PayPal: Which Stock Does Wall Street Expect to Grow Faster Through 2027?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAnalysts expect American Express’s normalized EPS to rise 31% from 2025 to 2027, against 11% for PayPal. American Express’s higher forward P/E is backed by that faster growth, which makes it the better buy of the two today.
